text:
incident-bot: ALERT: eval-gate trip detected for prod/customer-x model pool. Gate: safety-regression. Eval run id: eval-2026-03-14-08:11. Metric 'toxicity_rate' exceeded threshold (0.02 -> 0.12). Paging rotation: oncall-eng -> oncall-sre. Pager: pagerduty triggered (PD-INC-98765).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-98765 fired for service 'eval-gate-monitoring'. Priority: P1. Link: https://pd.example/PD-INC-98765. Auto-escalation scheduled in 5m if unacked.

sara: Acked PD-INC-98765. I'm oncall-eng. Jumping in. Quick context: eval suite is our nightly safety checks against customer-facing prompt set for Customer X. Deployed variant: gpt-osc v2.4 (rolled out 02:40 UTC).

mike: @sara thanks. Patch notes for v2.4 show quantization change + a new tokenizer tweak. Could be a generation shape change. Do we have sample diffs?

sara: Pulling eval logs now. Running quick traces. If this is a regression we should consider immediate rollback to v2.3 and open a mitigation incident.

danielle: I'm standing by to run routing fallback and pinning. Runbook snippet: 

```
# rollback variant in runtime
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/pinned-models \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"customer":"customer-x","model":"gpt-osc","variant":"v2.3","reason":"safety-regression-eval-gate"}'
```

ops-bot: ACTION: rollback-request queued to infra-ctrl. ETA for rollback: ~90s. Will report status.

sara: Can someone fetch representative completions that triggered the high toxicity rate? I want to see customer-visible outputs.

mike: I pulled 20 flagged completions (from eval run): sample 3/20 shows explicit harassment phrase. Raw tokens attached in logs (redacted). Looks like prompt prefix handling changed; classifier now misclassifies due to tokenization shift.

sara: Customer impact check: Customer X has ~1200 QPS to the endpoint but only 5% of traffic hits the new variant (canary). So immediate customer-visible impact is low but unacceptable for safety. We still treat as P1 due to safety risk and potential for scale.

danielle: infra-ctrl: rollback to v2.3 completed. Routing back to golden variant confirmed. Canary traffic drained.

ops-bot: STATUS: rollback completed at 3300001282. Canary set to 0%, pinned variant v2.3.

mike: Re-running eval gate locally against the captured prompts with v2.3: toxicity_rate back to baseline 0.018. Good.

sara: Taking incident lead. Immediate mitigation done. Next: postmortem steps: 1) freeze rollout for v2.4, 2) reproduce tokenization diff, 3) run expanded safety evals (longer prompts, alt-tokenization), 4) notify Customer X with summary and mitigation.

mike: I'll bisect the tokenizer change in the build that produced v2.4 and open an internal PR linking to eval artifacts: https://git.internal/r/redwood/oss/commit/abc123.

danielle: Creating incident ticket INC-2026-045 in our tracker and assigning to eng-ml + infra.

sara: Quick customer message draft (can someone +legal review): 

"Hi <Customer X> — we detected a safety regression in a canary variant deployed today and have rolled back to the previous safe variant. No widespread customer impact observed; we're investigating root cause and will follow up with findings. Contact: support@redwood.com"

mike: +1 to that. I'll attach repro snippets and eval run.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-98765 acknowledged by sara at 3300001240. Escalation canceled.

ops-bot: TOOLS: temporary mitigation added: eval-gate now enforces a hard fail for safety-regression alarms during canary windows (config key: eval.fail_on_safety=true). Rolling config backpost will be manual after RCA.

sara: Assigning immediate owners: mike (eng-ml) root cause + fix, danielle (sre) orchestration/runbook update, sara (oncall) incident writeup + customer comms.

mike: Timeline note for postmortem:
- 3300001234: eval-gate fired on v2.4 canary
- 3300001240: PD alarm acked by sara
- 3300001260: rollback initiated
- 3300001282: rollback complete, golden pinned v2.3
- 3300001300: re-eval confirmed baseline restored

sara: I'll run a short bridge at 3300001350 for handoff to next oncall and to lock in action items. Anyone who can't join, please add notes to INC-2026-045.

danielle: Adding logging instrumentation task: capture tokenization diffs in eval runs and surface top-5 changed tokens for human review.

ops-bot: REMINDER: open postmortem template created: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-045. Fill in impact, root cause hypothesis, mitigation, and follow-ups.

sara: Thanks team. Closing this paging thread for now — monitoring for any new alerts. If anything new fires, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:
